# Colecto v0.11.5

Patch release overhauling HTML email rendering on desktop and mobile, restoring the Linux systemd background service installer and AI re-label flow, adding undo send and move undo actions, and trimming notification noise.

## Changes

- **HTML email renderer overhaul**: Replaced the regex HTML parser on desktop and mobile with a real HTML5/CSS widget renderer (`flutter_widget_from_html_core`) and preserved safe, URL-free inline CSS properties in Rust's `ammonia` sanitizer (`display`, `width`, `height`, colors, borders, padding, typography, table layout). Small icons render at their actual dimensions without upscaling, oversized banners scale cleanly to the reader width, hidden `display:none` preheaders stay hidden, and designed corporate emails render on a readable light sheet in dark mode.
- **Undo send & quieter notifications**: Added a 5-second grace period when sending mail with a 4.5-second **Undo** toast that cancels dispatch and reopens the composer intact (and flushes immediately if you close the desktop window, unfocus Web, or minimize/close on mobile). Added **Undo** buttons to Archive, Move to Trash, and Move toasts, limited the zoom hint toast to once per session with the matching undo shortcut, and removed redundant confirmation toasts.
- **Settings auto-save & AI re-labeling**: AI model/rule fields and custom hex accents now auto-save as you edit without `"settings saved"` toast spam. Restored the bulk Inbox re-label flow (count picker with live batch progress) in Settings → AI and **Check labels again** in the message row and reader menus.
- **Linux systemd user services**: Restored the **Background services** section in Settings → Connection on Linux to install, update, start/stop, toggle start-on-login, and uninstall versioned `colecto-daemon.service` and `colecto-notifications.service` user units.
- **Mailbox, accounts & mobile UX**: Updated the message list footer to report `N messages loaded`, added persisted account reordering in Settings → Accounts and the account switcher, enabled vertical mouse-wheel scrolling on the reader tab strip, and switched non-long-tap mobile menus (including the account switcher) to modal screens/pickers.
- **Docs & tooling**: Updated `.github/SECURITY.md` and `docs/` to remove stale third-party extension references and moved `just/` modules into `scripts/just/`.
